SY338
Women and Development
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
A study of the place of women in 'developing areas', and a critique of existing development theory, policy and practice, The
course
focuses on issues such as gender politics, productive and reproductive labour, population policies and health, sexuality and reproductive rights, with an emphasis on the role of international agencies and aid.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
One of
AN200
,
GS211
,
SY210
(or SY204*),
SY213
, or
SY334
.
Exclusions
AN338, SY206w.
